description: Every patch into Terraria. Runtime Harmony patches only; no game file is modified.

patch.desc: Harmony patch kind ('call' = we call it).

rows.purpose: Terraria's normal start after our patches are registered.
Apply Harmony patches once the engine is up; load Cuphead cache textures.
Draw Cuphead / Mugman / Ms. Chalice picks on the character-create menu.
Persist which Cuphead kit is tied to this .plr when the player is saved from create.
Run Peashooter, EX, parry, dash/roll and Chalice double-jump for Cuphead kits.

rows.target: Terraria.Player:Hurt(PlayerDeathReason, int, int, bool, bool, bool, int, bool)
rows.purpose: Parry and dash i-frames cancel damage when active.

rows.target: Terraria.Main:DrawPlayer(Player, Vector2, float, Vector2, float, float, float)
rows.purpose: Draw Cuphead atlas frames when the cache is ready; otherwise keep vanilla draw.
